note: Yosemite, Glacier Point. For most of a century the hotel keepers pushed a bonfire off this rim every summer night, and the embers fell 3,000 feet to Camp Curry: the Firefall. The hole is the same journey. The tee is on the rim; the green is in the pines at the foot of the cliff, by Curry Village, half a mile out and more than half a mile down.
